title: Partial updates and moved elements drawn by a canvas
blurb: Streamed <template for> patches fill named ranges in tiles that a canvas draws, out of order, and moveBefore() reorders the tiles while an input keeps its focus. The canvas shows where each patch lands and flies each tile to its new place.
question: What does a canvas see when declarative partial updates (<template for> and processing-instruction ranges) change its children, when a patch adds a new drawable element, and when moveBefore() moves one?
result: Each chunk of a patch raises a paint event and changedElements names the patched tile only. A drawable element that arrives in a patch can be drawn at the next paint. moveBefore() keeps focus, animation time and the tile's texture. Only the Unsafe streaming methods apply patches.
